# Phone-book refinement by the root agent

1. Read the frozen v4 native phone-book construction and actual16.5s/18.5s source keyframes. Identified that generated phone numbers were placeholders, agent capsules began collapsing too early, final capsules were scaled to78% although the source holds near600px width, and the search capsule was missing from the17.5s stack.
2. Extracted exact native14.5s and17.5s PNGs with bounded single-thread FFmpeg. The14.5s source shows a staggered seven-row field;17.5s shows the full search capsule and three checked agents at approximatelyx659/y435,584,735.
3. Segmented the14.5s number field by observed row bands and whitespace between phone-number strings. Planned separately declared per-number artwork assets; no whole source frame or source-video layer is used.
4. Compared observed16.5s geometry with14.5s. Column spacing expands about1.20× while glyph width expands only about1.04×. A uniform camera scale cannot match both. The refinement separates grid spacing from per-number glyph scale and measures each from native reference frames.
5. Reused the source creator's initial glyph-outline tracing work as design guidance only; no script with mutation side effects was imported. Number strings remain declared bounded raster text artwork, with editability limits to be recorded.
6. Started one bounded single-thread native extraction covering13.7–17.4s at exact30fps frame indices. Top-row segmentation will constrain spread/size/opacity while capsule motion and final checked controls remain separate native layers.
7. First measured prototype produced native PNG MAE14.5=.085,16.5=1.48,17=.64,17.5=.70, but14s was nearly blank (MAE7.37). Diagnosis: early glyph spacing differs from a scaled later texture, and core-pixel opacity sampling missed shifted strokes. Added independently bounded earlier cell artwork and fitted the actual capsule outline bounds. Revised anchors improved14s to.00465 and17.5 to.1406;16.5 to1.242.
8. Densified the unfolding field at14.1/14.2/14.3/14.4. Measured row spacing is nonuniform near14s; one uniform camera scale cannot fit it. Autocorrelation measured column pitches377/401/422/440px. Added per-row measured positions and mass-based opacity fitting rather than an incorrect median of misaligned glyph pixels.
9. The first dense generator attempt failed on an empty crop. Root cause: opacity ROI variables reused the outer row's y0, so later number crops used the wrong row bounds. Its shell also continued to checkpoint capture after generator failure, producing stale-scene previews. Those previews are rejected. Renamed ROI variables, preserved the failed evidence separately, and made the dependent capture conditional on a successful generator exit before retrying.
10. Corrected dense-state metrics show remaining14.2MAE4.45/14.4MAE2.65 despite exact14.0/14.5anchors. Diagnosis: character positions change independently within each number; scaling a whole word texture cannot preserve kerning. A feasibility check found15stable glyph components across14.1–14.5 for a full number using adaptive ink thresholds. Built a per-glyph pose candidate; its first parse failed on one unmatched closing parenthesis before any mutation. Corrected the syntax and compiled before generation; dependent capture is conditional, so no stale-scene render follows a failed generator.
11. The first per-glyph candidate improved14.2MAE4.45→2.72 and14.4MAE2.65→1.68 while preserving14.0/14.5. Six words were conservatively kept because one observation had16components rather than15. Inspected actual component coordinates: every extra component touched the cell ROI boundary and belonged to a neighboring number. Rejected those boundary fragments before matching, rather than merging arbitrary real glyphs. This allows all unambiguous word trajectories to retain independent glyph poses.
12. Independent review prepared an ID-only query/Uber refinement so newer number/glyph changes remain intact. Native query anchors improve to regionalMAE.12–.315; full-opacity Uber16/16.3 to.067/.034, with the original correct faded16.5 pose preserved. Outside-range markup was checked at every other frame before merging. The reviewer caught and corrected a too-dark query ring and a faded sprite revealing an unwanted number underneath; its white backplate now has a separate lifetime.
13. The inherited15.5 selected-number disappearance has a concrete cause: the opacity sampler excluded dark pixels from14.5 onward to avoid provider-label contamination, but the source intentionally highlights selected phone numbers black before the provider cards arrive. Limited that exclusion to16s onward, then regenerate cell/glyph data before the final merged snapshot. This changes the actual selection state rather than concealing it behind a new generic background.

## Native every-frame unfold review

1. The all-frame v10 scan found frame 421 (14.033 s) at MAE 9.13. Earlier checks at tenths of a second missed the changing character spacing and optical softness between sparse anchors.
2. Scoped a correction to native frames 420–434. Preserved the previously accepted staggered birth at 415–419 and all later phonebook/capsule work. Measured seven actual number rows per frame and bounded text-cell contours, rather than interpolating a held phone-number texture.
3. The first native contour candidate improved 421 to 1.678 and 434 to .464. A control proof evaluated all 1,345 outside frames and found identical SVG markup. Native inspection showed the residual was primarily optical softness around glyphs, not the number positions.
4. Retried with five nested native contours per bounded number cell. Their cumulative opacities approximate the measured soft edge; this is semantic vector outline geometry, not live text or a full-frame raster. The next check measures all 15 changed frames and the unchanged frame 435.

5. The five-contour candidate passed every changed native frame: mean MAE .3509, maximum .6821 at 420; frame 421 is .6563 versus 9.13 before correction. All 1,345 outside frames remain markup-identical. Released the helper and measured scene with hashes for composition into the main v11 scene. This is a branch acceptance, followed by a required merged full-timeline scan.
